name: Cassava Pone
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3 lbs (1.36 kg) raw cassava, peeled and grated
½ tsp (2.5 ml) ground black pepper
4 tbsp (60 ml) melted butter or coconut oil
3 cups (720 ml) unsweetened evaporated milk or coconut milk

steps: Combine all the ingredients together, mixing well to incorporate.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Bake the cassava pone for 60 minutes until firm and golden.

culture.text: }}Cassava pone is a dessert originating in the Caribbean. This recipe is modified from one by Alica's Pepperpot.
